title: Critical quasilinear elliptic systems with convex subcritical perturbations
summary: We study a class of Dirichlet problems for coupled quasilinear elliptic systems driven by the $p$--Laplacian in a bounded domain, where the nonlinear terms split into a critical homogeneous part and a convex subcritical perturbation. Using variational methods, a nonlinear eigenvalue theory based on the Fadell--Rabinowitz $\mathbb Z_2$--cohomological index, and a refined linking construction, we prove the existence of a nontrivial solution for every parameter value under suitable dimensional assumptions.
